scientific_integrity: The proof separates prime powers, two odd prime supports, and supports \(\{2,p\}\). Parity, exact divisibility by prime squares, a discriminant factorization, and elementary growth inequalities close every branch. Finite computation is used only for regression.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only fixed points with \(\omega(n)\le2\); fixed points with three or more distinct prime factors remain outside its scope, and known large examples exist.
title: Two-prime-support rigidity for square-prime-factor fixed points
